purpose: Diagnose the observed Intel AppleClang violation of the existing stored-bit BBD history contract; production remains untouched.

probe.baseline_control: The previously observed original predicate must reject at least one required stored-nonzero case; otherwise this compiler diagnosis is inconclusive and the diagnostic job must fail.

unchanged_gate.baseline_control: The original gate must reproduce the sole named BBD history predicate failure; no assertion is removed, suppressed or modified.

mutation.replacement: Classify the original float through sample != 0.0f instead of the stored integer bits.
mutation.required_assertion: BBD history predicate classifies stored bits independently of denormal mode

evidence: Actual AppleClang compiler version and CMake-generated original target argument array
Assembly and LLVM IR for original and candidate no-inline functions
Complete original, candidate and floating-comparison mutation gate logs
Source/header/test/contract hashes, candidate and mutation patches, unchanged source status
limitations: Software compiler mechanism only. No tolerance changes, performance pass, hardware measurements or full native plugin qualification.
